name: url-report-plugin
description: Generate a Markdown report for a URL with its HTTP status code and page title.

interface.shortDescription: Fetch a URL title and HTTP status as Markdown.
interface.longDescription: A minimal Codex plugin example that runs a WSL Ubuntu shell script to inspect a website URL, collect the final HTTP status code, extract the HTML page title, and print a Markdown report.
defaultPrompt: Create a URL report for https://example.com
Fetch the title and HTTP status for this site.
Generate a Markdown report for a website URL.
